snippet.description:
What does a personal UPSC mentor actually do?

In this short, LevelUp IAS explains how LMP Ascend uses personalised mentorship to bring accountability into your UPSC preparation. Aspirants get a weekly one-on-one session with their personal mentor to track daily targets, review tests, discuss answer-writing performance and identify gaps in preparation.

If you fall behind your schedule, your mentor can also help you assess what went wrong, plan the next few weeks and get your preparation back on track.

The program also includes weekly group sessions with Super Mentors, adding another layer of guidance and accountability.

Learn more about LMP Ascend by LevelUp IAS:
https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-ascend-levelup-mentorship-program-lmp-ascend/
